title: Body bytes for repeated unchanged content
method: Synthetic 200 KiB body requested 100 times. Full bodies: 100 × 200 = 20,000 KiB. First body plus 99 unchanged 304 responses: 200 KiB body bytes. Headers, transport overhead and origin work excluded.
alt: Body bytes for repeated unchanged content. 100 full responses: 20000 KiB; One body plus validation: 200 KiB. Illustrative inputs.
